tasks.extracted: In a Saskatchewan cohort of 225 796 people prescribed benzodiazepines and 97 862 controls, the odds ratio for an injurious crash after a hypnotic prescription was 6.5 (95% CI 1.9 to 22.5) in weeks 1 to 2 and 3.9 (1.9 to 8.3) in weeks 1 to 4, falling to 1.4 in weeks 5 to 8; 3.2 (1.4 to 7.3) for triazolam and 5.1 (2.3 to 11.6) for flurazepam in weeks 1 to 4.
